[[File:Heritage Collection II.png|thumb|Pokémon: Heritage Collection II cover]] [[File:Heritage Collection II angled.png|thumb|Pokémon: Heritage Collection II box]] [[File:Heritage Collection II ball.png|thumb|Pokémon: Heritage Collection II Great Ball mould]] '''Pokémon: Heritage Collection II''' is a Region 4 DVD set released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia and New Zealand on November 11, 2015. It contains 40 discs with 331 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6368. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all of the episodes from [[season]]s [[S10|10]] to [[S16|16]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. The discs are contained in a large hand-painted [[Great Ball]] mould. The discs are separated by season, with each of the seven seasons in its own foldable pocket.
